name: longform-batch-delivery
whatsNew: v9 adds an explicit round contract and a four-phase loop. It pre-computes x = target / (per-turn cap x 0.8), runs GENERATE until the volume target is met (verified by several counting methods, including the built docx), then AUDIT -> if anything fails, REPAIR and re-audit, until gate exits 0. run_state.py gate is the only legal definition of done: 0=DONE, 1=keep writing, 2=fix first. Every turn must end with a DONE certificate or a RESUME line, never a question.
